files.workshop/service.py:
"""Job lifecycle for the machine-shop maintenance board."""


class JobError(Exception):
    """Raised when a job cannot move to its next state."""


def log_parts(job_id, parts, entries=[]):
    """Append a parts record to the shared shift log."""
    entries.append((job_id, parts))
    return entries


def complete_job(job, parts_used, ledger):
    """Mark a repair job finished and post the parts consumption."""
    job.state = "finished"
    ledger.post_parts(job.id, parts_used)
    return job.state


def schedule_followup(job, planner):
    """Queue a follow-up visit for any job that has been completed."""
    if job.state == "completed":
        planner.enqueue_followup(job.id)
        return True
    return False
